originality.rationale: Best-knowledge original all-field classification with a sharp h=J parity-dependent degeneracy crossing. The existing zero-field 2n count and saturation-field independent-set polynomial are covered prior work and explicitly not asserted as new. The independent-set formula and zero-field minimizers do not alone state the positive-field threshold J or the 4n crossing: the rung near-independent-set enumeration and cut-energy comparison supply these steps. No discovered record directly implied the full statement, though specialized earlier coverage remains possible.
residual_risks: A specialized source deriving the exact Möbius longitudinal-field phase diagram may exist beyond the inspected index and articles.
Finite-temperature Ising transfer methods may imply the result after a nontrivial zero-temperature field limit, but no such stronger treatment was identified.
Known endpoint counts are not novel and are excluded from the assessed new component.
